messages:
elena: Heads-up — customer (AcmeApp) reports repeated mid-stream disconnects when users switch from cellular -> WiFi. They see partial streamed output, then the SSE connection closes and the client immediately retries and hits 503s. Happening on iOS 16, our mobile SDK 1.4.2.

elena: Repro steps they gave: 1) start streaming chat -> server returns partial chunks, 2) toggle WiFi on device, 3) after ~10-40s stream closes with no final token, client does token refresh and reopens stream -> gets 503, sometimes immediate, sometimes after a few retries.

elena: Paste of client SDK log (redacted):
```
[2025-10-11T14:22:33.201Z] SSE: open -> requestId=rc-12a3
[2025-10-11T14:22:50.885Z] SSE: event chunk -> token: partial chunk
[2025-10-11T14:22:53.104Z] Network: wifi toggled -> interface changed (cellular->wifi)
[2025-10-11T14:23:05.407Z] SSE: close code=1006
[2025-10-11T14:23:05.410Z] HTTP: POST /v1/streams reopen -> status=503 x-request-id=yz-77
[2025-10-11T14:23:05.411Z] Auth: refresh token succeeded
[2025-10-11T14:23:06.000Z] SSE: reconnect attempt 1 -> status=503
```

elena: Customer worries this is a bug in our SDK because it used to resume more gracefully, and they lose the last partial content.

priya: thanks for the heads-up. can you grab the full client logs and the x-request-id shown in the 503 please? also is the SDK using resume id/Last-Event-ID header on reconnect?

elena: putting their raw 503 response headers below (redacted):
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Sat, 11 Oct 2025 14:23:05 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 123
X-Request-ID: yz-77
Retry-After: 3
Server: redwood-edge
X-Edge-Info: upstream-connection-reset
```

ben: pinging runtime / edge team — can someone check yz-77 in logs? 503 + upstream-connection-reset suggests the edge couldn't reach a backend or the connection was half-closed after the mobile handoff.

marcel: I see an uptick in similar 5xx patterns for SSE endpoints in region-us-east-1 around that minute. tagging @sre-bot to pull flow logs. quick theory: mobile network interface change causes TCP teardown; the edge/lb may have a short idle or keepalive that detects half-open sockets and returns 503 on new attempts while backend still cleaning up.

sre-bot: alert: increased 5xx errors for /v1/streams in us-east-1 between 14:22:40 - 14:24:00 (rate +6 sigma). Samples: requestId=yz-77, requestId=yz-98, requestId=yz-101. Correlating with network-change user agent strings.

priya: on the SDK side we currently do immediate reconnect with no jitter after a close; we also don't attach a resume id unless the app explicitly asks for resumable streams. can the server return Last-Event-ID style hints? we should probably add exponential backoff + resume id by default.

aisha: quick Q — could this be auth-related (expired tokens) or billing throttles? logs show token refresh succeeded right before reconnect so likely not auth. also billing doesn't match a per-customer throttle pattern.

ben: checked runtime logs for yz-77: upstream reported ECONNRESET when proxying to gpu-node-33. backend reported: "client reset during write" and our LB returned 503. attaching simplified trace lines: 
```
edge(yz-77) -> lb(i-12) proxy -> gpu-node-33: write error EINTR/ECONNRESET
edge: return 503 to client; no backend available for immediate retry
```

marcel: actionable short-term: 1) ask customer to upgrade to SDK 1.4.3-beta which has a fix for graceful resume + starts sending a resume token, 2) advise client to add jittered exponential backoff on reconnects (avoid tight reconnect loops), 3) we'll add a keepalive header suggestion. medium-term: review LB keepalive / tcp timeouts for streaming endpoints.

elena: customer is on a tight timeline. they requested repro steps we can run against their account. I'll ask them to capture a tcpdump during the handoff and share. also will try 1.4.3-beta with them.

priya: new SDK beta note for support: the beta now sends header `X-Resume-Token` on every SSE chunk and will set `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect if available. also adds 250-2000ms jitter on reconnect attempts by default. link to beta: https://internal.redwood.dev/mobile-sdk/1.4.3-beta

deploy-bot: deploy: no runtime-edge deploys in last 24h; last config change to LB happened 6 days ago (no changes to idle_timeout).

ben: interesting — LB idle_timeout is 30s for upstreams. if the handoff leaves a half-open connection >30s, it may get cleaned up. but here the close is roughly ~12s after interface change. suspect combination of client reconnect flood + backend write failing.

marcel: for mitigation on our side I'll propose: increase upstream keepalive probe frequency for streams and add a short grace retry at the edge before returning 5xx for idempotent stream opens (so we don't immediately surface 503 when backend is transient). filing infra ticket.

aisha: asked customer to try SDK beta and to enable client-side resume when possible. also asked them to set `Connection: keep-alive` on the initial request. gave them repro checklist.

elena: customer tried beta and saw immediate improvement — most reconnects resumed and they got the final token. one user still hit a 503 once. customer is happy with workaround but wants a permanent fix.

marcel: filing INFRA-2197 to adjust edge behavior and INFRA-2198 for additional probes. priya please file MOBILE-432 for GA SDK resume behavior and default reconnect jitter.

priya: will do. thanks. i'll also add an opt-in telemetry flag so we can detect how often handoffs trigger resumes.

elena: summary for customer: root cause likely network handoff -> TCP connection teardown + backend write/reset -> edge returns 503 while backend cleans up. short-term fix = SDK 1.4.3-beta (resume token + jitter) + client keepalive; medium-term = infra changes (keepalive/probes and brief retry at edge).

elena: closing loop with customer tomorrow after infra tickets created. :thumbsup:
